{{Article header|deck=Compare documented mining commodities by extraction method, environment, and required equipment.}}

{{Callout|type=tip|label=Quick answer|1=Choose the commodity first, then match its documented environment to the correct extraction method. A named hotspot does not make every method valid there: laser, core, sub-surface, asteroid surface-deposit, and planetary surface mining use different equipment and may have different commodity availability.}}

'''Mining Commodities''' is EDFM's comparison directory for mineable cargo commodities with structured acquisition records. The table identifies documented extraction methods and environments without reproducing the complete workflow for each activity. Individual commodity articles own distribution, acquisition, uses, and market context; the mining procedures own fitting and extraction instructions.

These commodities occupy cargo storage. They are distinct from [[Engineering Materials]], which use separate material inventories.

== Commodity comparison ==

{{Mining commodities}}

'''Unknown does not mean No.''' Unknown means availability by that method has not been established. No indicates evidence against a method rather than a missing report. Evidence labels also distinguish official information, game data, community documentation, and unverified claims.

Environments are tied to particular methods. A ring that supports core mining for a commodity may not support a laser-mining route for the same commodity. Listed environments are documented places to look, not necessarily an exhaustive distribution.

'''Asteroid surface deposits''' are deposits removed with an [[Abrasion Blaster]]. '''Planetary surface mining''' is the separate ground-based activity performed with a [[Rhino]]. Neither is the same as asteroid sub-surface mining.

== Commodity articles ==

* '''[[Gold]]''' — a metal obtained through a documented Metallic-ring laser route and used for [[Lei Cheung]]'s workshop unlock.
* '''[[Painite]]''' — a mineral with documented Metallic-ring laser and Metal Rich core routes, required by [[Selene Jean]].
* '''[[Iridium]]''' — a metal obtained through planetary surface mining, with EDFM community prospecting observations.
* '''[[Ruby]]''' — a planetary surface-mined gemstone with EDFM community prospecting observations.

== Method guides ==

* [[How to Laser Mine]] — extracting fragments from asteroid composition.
* [[Surface Deposit Mining]] — removing exposed deposits from asteroid surfaces.
* [[How to Sub-surface Mine]] — drilling sub-surface asteroid deposits.
* [[How to Core Mine]] — locating and cracking core asteroids.
* [[Surface Mining with the Rhino]] — locating and extracting planetary deposits.
* [[Mining Hotspot]] — understanding hotspot signals and choosing the correct ring and method.

Before travelling to buy or sell cargo, check current market stock, demand, report age, docking access, and carrier permissions. This directory describes acquisition routes rather than live offers or guaranteed earnings.
